title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: call quality feedback surveys after meetings
notes: claim 64: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The survey default, roadmap details, licensing and Cloud Policy control are supported. The operational guidance still sends administrators to the Teams admin center without accounting for Android room management being retired there during November; Microsoft now directs them to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal. Two descriptive statements also lack supporting text.
